sentences.l2: ライドシェアは、車にのりたい人と、のせたい人をつなぎます。
sentences.l1: Ridesharing connects people who want to ride in a car with people who want to give rides.

sentences.l2: のりたい人がおおいと、価格設定のアルゴリズムが、ねだんを高くします。
sentences.l1: When many people want to ride, the pricing algorithm raises the price.

sentences.l2: これは経済学で、市場のねだんがかわるしくみです。
sentences.l1: In economics, this is the mechanism by which market prices change.
